summary: ZenRadius Mobile API v1 + Expo frontend tested end-to-end. Backend: 47/47 pytest tests PASSED (1 skipped - no unpaid invoice for first pelanggan after admin pay flow consumed it, expected). All contract/RBAC/IDOR/envelope/reseller-balance assertions pass. Frontend: Connect→Login→Dashboard→Logout exercised for ALL 6 roles (admin, customer_service, teknisi, reseller, kolektor, pelanggan). Role-specific tab sets rendered correctly per spec. Session persists across reload (SecureStore). Pelanggan create-ticket FAB works and persists via API. Server URL validation rejects malformed input. Navy cyberpunk UI consistent and uses real seeded data (no mock).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 900 lines and handles auth, dashboards, invoices, tickets, reseller, notifications, profile and seed in one module. Consider splitting into routers/<domain>.py modules for maintainability (not blocking).
pwd.verify is called in auth login path 5x sequentially regardless of match; while safe, consider short-circuit on identifier type to reduce bcrypt CPU under load (not blocking).

/api/mobile/v1/auth/refresh rotates the access_hash in place; refresh should return a new refreshToken too for refresh-token rotation hygiene. Current behavior is acceptable but less secure than rotating refresh tokens.
No rate-limiting on /auth/login — brute-force protection is absent (acceptable for reference server but note for production parity).

/invoices/{iid} returns 403 for reseller via explicit guard but staff/pelanggan/kolektor path implicitly allows kolektor to read any invoice (no area check on detail GET, only on pay). Minor info-leak — kolektor can GET invoices outside their area. Consider adding area check in invoice_detail for role=kolektor.
seed_data_creation: None manually. Backend auto-seeds on startup (packages, cashiers, technicians, collectors, agents, 8 customers, 24 invoices, 4 tickets). Tests consumed one unpaid invoice via admin-pay and one via reseller-pay; these are TEST-marked in paid_by_name.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_zenradius_mobile_api.py is parametrized across all roles and covers login/me/refresh/logout, dashboard per role, customers RBAC, invoice IDOR, pay-invoice RBAC, pelanggan payment-link, ticket create/take/resolve, reseller prices/lookup/pay (asserts balance decrement), notifications, change-password admin-blocked. Run with: `cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://zenradius-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest tests/test_zenradius_mobile_api.py -v -o addopts=''`. Note: pytest-xdist is enabled by default via pytest.ini; override addopts to run sequentially (required because the shared `tokens` session fixture is not xdist-safe and test ordering across workers can revoke admin session). Frontend uses testIDs consistently: server-url-input, test-connection-button, connect-continue-button, login-identifier-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, header-profile-button, logout-button, create-ticket-fab, reseller-lookup-input, reseller-balance.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no production bugs found. One test-infrastructure fix was applied: initial `test_refresh` used the shared admin session's refresh token which rotates the admin access_hash in Mongo, invalidating subsequent admin-token tests. Replaced with a dedicated kasir login for the refresh assertion. After this fix, 47/47 pass.
